entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I had done this countless times now..."
entries.dialogueText: I had done this countless times now. Far too often. My wife, my father, and so many others.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But I had never expected that I wou..."
entries.dialogueText: But I had never expected that I would have to bury my own daughter.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Make way. Make way for the Princes..."
entries.dialogueText: "Make way. Make way for the Princess of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As per tradition, Hugo was leading..."
entries.dialogueText: As per tradition, Hugo was leading the cortège. Around us were thousands of people, crying for their Princess.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We arrived at the entrance to the N..."
entries.dialogueText: We arrived at the entrance to the National Mausoleum. Hugo stopped and I moved over to the front.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He knelt before me."
entries.dialogueText: He knelt before me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I handed him the sword."
entries.dialogueText: I handed him the sword.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""An offering for the Heiress's pass..."
entries.dialogueText: "An offering for the Heiress's passage into Golconda, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I handed him the rose."
entries.dialogueText: I handed him the rose.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I handed him the feather."
entries.dialogueText: I handed him the feather.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The sword is heavy. Sharp and stro..."
entries.dialogueText: "The sword is heavy. Sharp and strong."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I handed him the gold coin."
entries.dialogueText: I handed him the gold coin.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The rose has thorns. Beautiful and..."
entries.dialogueText: "The rose has thorns. Beautiful and defiant."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The feather is light. Free and flo..."
entries.dialogueText: "The feather is light. Free and flowing."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The gold is heart. Generous and gr..."
entries.dialogueText: "The gold is heart. Generous and gracious."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And so, Vina passes.""
entries.dialogueText: "And so, Vina passes."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned to the crowd and held it..."
entries.dialogueText: He turned to the crowd and held it high. Silence was deafening. His voice roared.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The first of her name. Daughter of..."
entries.dialogueText: "The first of her name. Daughter of Romus I. Daughter of the late Princess Consort Lena. Princess of Rizia. Heir to Valenqiris and the lands of Rizia Imperii."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "To my left was my mother. Her eyes..."
entries.dialogueText: To my left was my mother. Her eyes were still red from crying, but she held her head up high.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How are you holding up, Mother?""
entries.dialogueText: "How are you holding up, Mother?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I stayed silent."
entries.dialogueText: I stayed silent.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Losing Lena, then Vina...""
entries.dialogueText: "Losing Lena, then Vina..."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""The women of this family must be c..."
entries.dialogueText: "The women of this family must be cursed."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Perhaps it really is my fault. A c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps it really is my fault. A commoner tainting the Toras bloodline and dooming its heirs."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""You won't die too, will you, darli..."
entries.dialogueText: "You won't die too, will you, darling? I want you to promise me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She turned to me with a serious loo..."
entries.dialogueText: She turned to me with a serious look.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I promise, mother.""
entries.dialogueText: "I promise, mother."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I did not answer."
entries.dialogueText: I did not answer.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A single tear fell down her cheek."
entries.dialogueText: A single tear fell down her cheek.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""We must... pay our respects.""
entries.dialogueText: "We must... pay our respects."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her voice broke off."
entries.dialogueText: Her voice broke off.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She gripped my arm as the flag of R..."
entries.dialogueText: She gripped my arm as the flag of Rizia was removed by ceremonial guardsmen, revealing Vina's serene face. There was an undeniable calmness about her.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Oh, my dearest Vina.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, my dearest Vina."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""What did they do to you? How did w..."
entries.dialogueText: "What did they do to you? How did we let this happen?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She stood and went toward Vina as h..."
entries.dialogueText: She stood and went toward Vina as her grief took over.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I let her go."
entries.dialogueText: I let her go.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I quietly gestured for her to sit d..."
entries.dialogueText: I quietly gestured for her to sit down.
entries.menuText: Quietly gesture for her to return to her seat.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I joined her."
entries.dialogueText: I joined her.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Can't a grandmother say her farewe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can't a grandmother say her farewells?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Come back. That's an order.""
entries.dialogueText: "Come back. That's an order."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She reluctantly returned to her sea..."
entries.dialogueText: She reluctantly returned to her seat.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her voice wavered. She didn't sound..."
entries.dialogueText: Her voice wavered. She didn't sound like her usual self.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""I never said goodbye before she le..."
entries.dialogueText: "I never said goodbye before she left for Pales. The last thing I told her was to watch her waistline..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Several ceremonial guardsmen picked..."
entries.dialogueText: Several ceremonial guardsmen picked up the sarcophagus lid.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She went up alongside Vina's stone..."
entries.dialogueText: She went up alongside Vina's stone encasement and stood for a moment. After whispering a few words, she gripped its sides, as if reluctant to let go.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo allowed her some time before g..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo allowed her some time before gently guiding her back to her seat.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She went up alongside Vina's stone..."
entries.dialogueText: She went up alongside Vina's stone encasement.

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Oh, my darling girl. If I was hars..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, my darling girl. If I was harsh on you, it was because you were my favorite person in the world."

entries.speaker: Queen Mother Estela
entries.title: Estela Toras: ""Farewell, Your Highness. Your gran..."
entries.dialogueText: "Farewell, Your Highness. Your grandmother will love you forever."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I stepped forward, taking the place..."
entries.dialogueText: I stepped forward, taking the place where my mother had been, to say my final words to Vina.
entries.menuText: Say your final words to Vina.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I returned to my seat."
entries.dialogueText: I returned to my seat.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am sorry.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I love you.""
entries.dialogueText: "I love you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Say hello to your mother for me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Say hello to your mother for me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will never forgive myself.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will never forgive myself."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will avenge you.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will avenge you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I kissed her on the forehead and we..."
entries.dialogueText: I kissed her on the forehead and went back to my throne.

entries.title: Narrator: "A vessel filled with molten gold wa..."
entries.dialogueText: A vessel filled with molten gold was presented to me by a guardsman. I was handed protective gloves, allowing me to grip it without harm.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "Together, we poured the molten gold..."
entries.dialogueText: Together, we poured the molten gold over Vina's stone coffin.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I watched the gold solidify, I f..."
entries.dialogueText: As I watched the gold solidify, I felt weak. Frail.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Just like my father."
entries.dialogueText: Just like my father.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was customary for me, as both he..."
entries.dialogueText: It was customary for me, as both her father and the King of Rizia, to present an offering for the Heiress's passage into Golconda.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I presented a sword."
entries.dialogueText: I presented a sword.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I presented a rose."
entries.dialogueText: I presented a rose.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I presented a feather."
entries.dialogueText: I presented a feather.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I presented a gold coin."
entries.dialogueText: I presented a gold coin.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Around me were thousands of people,..."
entries.dialogueText: Around me were thousands of people, crying for their Princess.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It wasn't long before we entered th..."
entries.dialogueText: It wasn't long before we entered the tomb, where Vina's sarcophagus, draped in the Rizian flag, had been placed next to her mother's. The lid was laid off to the side.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The sword is heavy. Sharp and stro..."
entries.dialogueText: "The sword is heavy. Sharp and strong."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The rose has thorns. Beautiful and..."
entries.dialogueText: "The rose has thorns. Beautiful and defiant."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The feather is light. Free and flo..."
entries.dialogueText: "The feather is light. Free and flowing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The gold is heart. Generous and gr..."
entries.dialogueText: "The gold is heart. Generous and gracious."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her resting place, like that of all..."
entries.dialogueText: Her resting place, like that of all royals, had been prepared early on in life, a precaution for when the inevitable came.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I held it up for all to see."
entries.dialogueText: I held it up for all to see.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Only a select few were permitted to..."
entries.dialogueText: Only a select few were permitted to enter -- immediate family, close relatives, and high-ranking nobility. The rest of the crowd remained outside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we moved through the corridor, a..."
entries.dialogueText: As we moved through the corridor, a hushed reverence fell over the smaller group, a stark contrast to the swelling voices from beyond the stone walls.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And so, Vina passes. The first of..."
entries.dialogueText: "And so, Vina passes. The first of her name. Daughter of Romus I. Daughter of late Queen Lena. Princess of Rizia. Heir to the lands of Rizia Imperii."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The crowd began to collectively pra..."
entries.dialogueText: The crowd began to collectively pray and chant her name as I went inside the mausoleum.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With overcast skies above and a lig..."
entries.dialogueText: With overcast skies above and a light drizzle falling, I arrived at the entrance to the National Mausoleum.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""May this offering guide her to the..."
entries.dialogueText: "May this offering guide her to the realms beyond, where her ancestors await. "

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Vina, your journey has ended too s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Vina, your journey has ended too soon. May this gift be a token of my love, to accompany you as you cross into the afterlife."
